items.text:
The FBI Anti-Corruption Squad Was Circling Susan Collins — Until Trump Got in the Way
Reporting Highlights

Probe: In 2024, the FBI sought to launch a sweeping pay-to-play investigation examining interactions between Sen. Susan Collins and a top donor, records and emails show.

Confession: The donor, an ex-defense contractor, told agents his company won millions in federal contracts by bankrolling campaigns of powerful politicians.

Shutdown: After Donald Trump returned to office, the investigation died, a casualty of his purge of the FBI. Its closure shut a potential window into how Washington works.

Then Trump returned to the White House. Consumed by a campaign of vengeance, he stacked the Department of Justice with his personal lawyers and demanded a purge of anyone who had ever investigated him.

The specialized FBI and DOJ teams handling public corruption investigations, some of which were involved in Trump-related cases, were eviscerated. One of the agents who had taken Kao’s confession was pushed out as retribution for her role in investigating Trump’s attempt to overturn the 2020 election. Dozens of agents and prosecutors quit amid the department’s destruction, including the career attorney assigned to Kao’s case.

Trump’s Justice Department no longer takes on public corruption in any meaningful fashion, former officials said. The investigation sparked by Kao’s revelations is dead. And the government is no longer talking to an informant who had offered a road map to corruption in Congress.

sharedPost.text:
URGENT: 167,639 pounds of beef, pork, and goat meat are being recalled after it was discovered they had fake USDA inspection labels. 

Health officials are warning that the recalled products “may contain undeclared allergens, harmful bacteria, or other contaminants that put consumer health and safety at risk.”

Over 80 tons of meat were distributed under the A&D Foods label and include sliced ribeye, thin-sliced beef chuck, beef oxtail, beef short ribs, bone-in shanks, ground pork, pork chorizo, pork chops, pork feet, pork rib, Boston pork, Menudo Mix, pork hock, beef ribs, beef feet, goat, and skin-on goat burn. 

The defective product was shipped to a distributor in Georgia and later sold in stores and restaurants nationwide.

The USDA is strongly warning consumers that the “products should be thrown away or returned to the place of purchase.” 

This is the latest major recall under Trump and RFK Jr. Just last month, 30,000 pounds of imported beef were recalled after it was discovered they did not receive proper inspection.

items.groupTitle: You Know What Concerns Me These Days - Tell Me
You Know What Concerns Me These Days - Tell Me

sharedPost.text:
Donna Ganger, mom of Renee Good: "I voted for President Trump under the impression that these agents were here to protect the citizens of the US, innocents like our family and the others here, against terrorists. Certainly not to accuse those of us here of being terrorists and take precious lives."

Madam, may I ask if it's an appropriate time for us to understand why you back someone like Donald Trump, who is known for having questionable ethics and racist views, and expect a positive outcome?
